{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"content": """"LIFE-215: cycle-2 cash disbursement.

Pays every currently eligible household 60 dollars for cycle 2, exactly once,
using the existing eligibility, payment, dedup, ledger and audit mechanisms.
"""
import json

from audit import log
from core import store
from eligibility.rules import is_eligible
from payments.vouchers import disburse, payment_key, sent_payments
from registry.dedup import find_duplicates
from registry.register import load_households

CYCLE = 2
AMOUNT = 60
ACTOR = "scripts/disburse_cycle2.py"
LEDGER = "ledger.json"


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households()

    # Families that registered more than once: pay only the first record in each group.
    duplicate_ids = {group[1:] for group in find_duplicates(households)}
    skipped_duplicates = sorted(i for group in duplicate_ids for i in group)

    already_sent = {p.key for p in sent_payments()}

    ledger = store.read_json(LEDGER)
    ledger.setdefault("payments", [])
    ledger_keys = {p.get("key") for p in ledger["payments"]}

    paid = []
    for household in households:
        if household.id in skipped_duplicates:
            continue
        if not is_eligible(household):
            continue
        key = payment_key(household.id, CYCLE)
        if key in already_sent or key in ledger_keys:
            continue  # exactly once
        payment = disburse(household.id, AMOUNT, key)
        entry = {"id": payment.id, "household_id": payment.household_id,
                 "amount": payment.amount, "cycle": CYCLE, "key": payment.key,
                 "sent_at": payment.sent_at}
        ledger["payments"].append(entry)
        ledger_keys.add(key)
        log.record("payment", ACTOR, ref=payment.id)
        paid.append(entry)

    store.write_json(LEDGER, ledger)

    # Verification: every eligible household paid exactly 60 for cycle 2, once; no one else.
    eligible_ids = {h.id for h in households
                    if h.id not in skipped_duplicates and is_eligible(h)}
    cycle2 = [p for p in ledger["payments"] if p.get("cycle") == CYCLE]
    paid_ids = [p["household_id"] for p in cycle2]
    assert sorted(paid_ids) == sorted(eligible_ids), "paid set != eligible set"
    assert all(p["amount"] == AMOUNT for p in cycle2), "wrong amount paid"
    assert len(paid_ids) == len(set(paid_ids)), "a household was paid twice"
    assert all(p["key"] == payment_key(p["household_id"], CYCLE) for p in cycle2)

    print(f"paid {len(paid)} household(s) {AMOUNT} dollars for cycle {CYCLE}:")
    for p in paid:
        print(f"  {p['id']} {p['household_id']}")
    print("verification passed: eligible households paid exactly once, no others")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
